findings: Tasks carries inputDigest and inputPackages together through observation and final reporting. Turbo digest reads supply package names; declared digests, failed lanes and unavailable digest sources retain empty package scope.

QualityTaskLaneRun defaults missing inputPackages to an empty array. The array schema itself does not enforce sortedness or uniqueness. Root tasks contribute no package names; scope metadata does not establish complete semantic inputs.
Proof-session preparation errors are mapped to QualityTaskConfigurationError. Shared CI detection replaces the local predicate and Crypto requirements propagate through task execution.
Diagnostic scans add scratchpad and nonrecursive repository-root TypeScript files. The explicit exemption tuple adds vitest.shared.ts for nodeBuiltinImport; recursive roots remain separately scanned.

Residue command wiring adds fleet discovery, Turbo-run age, shared-cache age/size and qualification-view retention flags. Defaults include fleet=false, one-day run summaries, fourteen-day shared-cache age, 21474836480 bytes and two retained views. Help reports the v2 contract.

Human residue output groups by checkout or home, caps rows at 25 per class/section, orders eligible before skipped, and reports skip counts. JSON retains the full candidate list. Qualification-view bytes are described as apparent-only.
Residue apply and fleet discovery are filesystem/orchestration effects, not pure reusable quality computations. No workstation cleanup was executed for this review.

recoveredRun.evidence: Retained Vitest completion summary reports two passing files.

retainedRun.scope: Three-suite run includes quality-tasks.test.ts; not 312 task-runner tests. Relevant Quality sources and quality-tasks.test.ts are unchanged from its source revision.

remaining: All 13 broader census obligations remain open.
This is a three-file historical delta review, not exhaustive janitor implementation, dynamic command execution or transitive input closure.
Passing fixtures and metadata do not establish signed remote replay, complete log capture or any qualified tuple.
